verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at doc.anytype.io (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as raw .md pages, so an agent can be pointed straight at it. Further agent-oriented material includes an AGENTS.md in the repo, an Anytype Agents Skill doc for Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools, and a machine-readable OpenAPI v2 spec 'built for agents and humans.' Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or an llms.txt on the developer portal.
